verdict.rationale: Published delegation rules are a fair question for a national company registry: authorization forms, the roles of intermediaries or professionals filing on a company's behalf, and which signatures must stay personal. The pack holds only two probes recording HTTP 403 walls at mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in robots.txt, so nothing about delegation forms, third-party roles or non-delegable signatures was observed. The low confidence reflects that this is an access wall, not a confirmed absence.
